gnupg_path.description: The path to the GnuPG binary used for encryption/decryption/signing.

mailer_path.description: The path to the Pine/Alpine mailer binary.

cache_dir.description: Directory where Topal caches decrypted message output to minimize passphrase prompts.

cache_size.description: Maximum number of entries to keep in the decryption cache.

use_cache.description: Whether to enable caching of decryption operations.

sig_log.description: Path to the log file for signature verification events.

key_ring.description: Path to the default secret keyring file.

identity_file.description: Path to the file containing user identity configuration.
